brand.title: Start from your website
brand.sub: Paste your website. We read it and an AI drafts your value proposition and three ideal customers. Nothing is used until you've reviewed it.
brand.draftSub: Drafted by an AI from your website. Edit anything that isn't right: creators see it in every brief.
brand.readFailed: We couldn't read {url}. This draft starts from your company name — edit it before you finish.
brand.alreadySetUp: Your brand is already set up. Change these details in Settings.

linkedin.title: Add your LinkedIn profile
linkedin.sub: Paste your public profile URL. We fill your card from it: headline, followers, country and photo. Anything a public profile doesn't show stays blank.
linkedin.imported: Profile read. Check your card on the next step.
linkedin.failedBody: Enter it by hand instead. We never invent numbers: anything we couldn't read stays blank.
linkedin.privacy: We read only your public profile, and only once.

card.title: Build your card
card.sub: Your headline, country and up to three industries. The preview shows the card brands will see as you type.

price.title: Set your price
price.sub: One fixed net price per post, plus up to three bundles if you want them. You can change both later.

legal.title: Your legal details
legal.sub: Needed to invoice brands and pay you: your tax country, business status, legal name and address, and two confirmations.
legal.laterNote: You can finish this later in Settings. It's needed before you apply, accept a booking or withdraw.
